# Beyond Horizons by Bethel Chambers LLC

> Beyond Horizons by Bethel Chambers LLC is a practice group of Bethel Chambers LLC, which is licensed and regulated by the Legal Services Regulatory Authority (LSRA). It provides Singapore-anchored, cross-border legal counsel for boards, founders and senior executives across APAC, the EU, the UK and the Americas.

Beyond Horizons by Bethel Chambers LLC provides outsourced general counsel, cross-border transaction advisory, legacy wealth planning, and regulatory compliance services. The firm serves entrepreneurs, family offices, and technology-driven enterprises across aviation, robotics, space, blockchain, cybersecurity and other sectors.

Key facts:

- Legal entity: Bethel Chambers LLC, a Singapore law corporation (UEN 202007868D). Beyond Horizons is a practice group of Bethel Chambers LLC, which is licensed and regulated by the Legal Services Regulatory Authority (LSRA), a department under the Singapore Ministry of Law.
- Founder: Hui Ling Teo (also written Teo Hui Ling), Founder of Beyond Horizons by Bethel Chambers LLC. She is qualified as a solicitor in England and Wales and as an advocate and solicitor in Singapore, and has 14 years of experience.
- Individual rankings of Hui Ling Teo: Ranked Band 3 for Aviation: Finance in Singapore and Band 4 for Aviation: Finance in the Asia-Pacific Region by Chambers Asia-Pacific 2026; Band 3 in the Chambers Global 2026 Asset Finance: Global Market Leaders table; and named a Next Generation Partner for Asset Finance (Singapore) in The Legal 500 Asia Pacific 2026.
- Laws covered: Singapore law and English law only; English-law advice is given through Hui Ling Teo. Where a matter needs advice on another country's law, the client instructs and pays local counsel in that country directly, and Beyond Horizons works alongside them.
- Office: 39B Neil Road, #03-01, Singapore 088823.
- Contact: HL@beyondhorizons.sg

- [Aviation finance and leasing counsel in Singapore](https://beyondhorizons.sg/industry/aviation): Counsel for lessors, airlines and financiers on English-law leases and financings, Cape Town Convention steps, and aircraft recoveries and repossession-adjacent work.
- [Singapore aviation law and regulation](https://beyondhorizons.sg/singapore-aviation-law): Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS) approvals, foreign operator permits, private aviation compliance, charter operator checks and Cape Town interfaces.
- [Fractional General Counsel Singapore](https://beyondhorizons.sg/industry/fractional-gc): What a fractional general counsel is, how it compares with employing a lawyer or taking an agency placement, and how a scoped Beyond Horizons retainer works.

- [Hui Ling Teo, Founder](https://beyondhorizons.sg/team/hui-ling-teo): Qualifications, rankings and how to instruct her.

## Key questions

- [Is Beyond Horizons a law firm, and how is it related to Bethel Chambers LLC?](https://beyondhorizons.sg/about): Beyond Horizons is a practice group of Bethel Chambers LLC, a Singapore law corporation licensed and regulated by the Legal Services Regulatory Authority (LSRA). Hui Ling Teo is its Founder.
- [Who can advise a lessor or financier on an aircraft repossession in Singapore or elsewhere in Asia-Pacific?](https://beyondhorizons.sg/industry/aviation): Beyond Horizons advises lessors and financiers from Singapore on the English-law lease documents, the Cape Town Convention and IDERA (Irrevocable De-registration and Export Request Authorisation) steps, and the cross-border coordination around aircraft recoveries. Court and registry steps in other countries sit with local counsel, whom the client instructs and pays directly. Hui Ling Teo has acted for lessors and creditors on many aircraft repossessions across Asia-Pacific, including complex matters with competing creditor claims and possessory liens; no particular outcome is promised.
- [Which law governs most aircraft leases and financings, and who advises on it from Singapore?](https://beyondhorizons.sg/industry/aviation): Most aviation finance and leasing matters Beyond Horizons sees are governed by English law. Hui Ling Teo advises on those documents and coordinates the Singapore-law pieces, such as security, filings and opinions, when the deal needs them.
- [What approvals does a foreign charter or business aviation operator need to fly into Singapore?](https://beyondhorizons.sg/singapore-aviation-law): According to CAAS, as at October 2026, a foreign operator flying commercial air transport, including charters, into or out of Singapore must first hold an Air Operator Certificate (AOC), or an aerial-work approval, from its home state and then obtain a Foreign Operator's Permit; each non-scheduled flight generally also needs an Air Transport permit. The guide explains these steps and the Cape Town interfaces.
- [What is a fractional general counsel, and how does Beyond Horizons provide one?](https://beyondhorizons.sg/industry/fractional-gc): A fractional general counsel is a senior lawyer retained by your organisation on a scoped, part-time basis, instead of employed full-time. Beyond Horizons provides this as a retainer with a regulated Singapore law practice, with a named lead counsel and a named deputy, and scope and fees fixed in the engagement letter before work begins.
- [Who advises founders and family-owned companies on business succession in Singapore?](https://beyondhorizons.sg/singapore-business-succession-lawyer): Beyond Horizons advises on the Singapore-law side of business succession: who will own the company, who will run it, and what happens if a founder dies, loses capacity or wants to exit. Hui Ling Teo, Founder, leads each matter, and advice can be given in English or Mandarin; wills and estates are handled by Bethel Chambers LLC.
- [Who acts for lenders or borrowers on English-law facilities with Singapore parties?](https://beyondhorizons.sg/singapore-lender-finance-counsel): Beyond Horizons acts for banks, private banks and credit funds as lenders on English-law facilities with Singapore obligors, security, demands and recovery. Borrower-side work for sponsors and individuals is described at https://beyondhorizons.sg/singapore-borrower-finance-counsel.
- [Who advises pet owners and pet businesses in Singapore?](https://beyondhorizons.sg/singapore-pet-law): Beyond Horizons advises pet owners and pet businesses on licensing, AVS and National Parks Board (NParks) notices, and the contracts and disputes that come with keeping, selling, boarding, grooming and training animals. It is not a personal injury or criminal defence practice.
- [How do I contact Beyond Horizons or instruct Hui Ling Teo?](https://beyondhorizons.sg/team/hui-ling-teo): Email HL@beyondhorizons.sg with the names of the parties, a short description of the matter or asset, and your timing, so that a conflict check can be run before you send any documents. The office is at 39B Neil Road, #03-01, Singapore 088823.

Educational only; not legal or financial advice, and no lawyer-client relationship is created.

- [Singapore Robotics Law](https://beyondhorizons.sg/singapore-robotics-law): Autonomous vehicles, service & industrial robots, AI risk overlay.
- [Singapore Employment Law](https://beyondhorizons.sg/singapore-employment-law): MOM compliance, work passes (COMPASS), retrenchments and executive separations.
- [Singapore Restructuring & Insolvency](https://beyondhorizons.sg/singapore-restructuring-insolvency): Schemes, JM, IRDA, cross-border recognition and distressed M&A.

- [Singapore Pet Law](https://beyondhorizons.sg/singapore-pet-law): General guidance for pet owners and pet businesses in Singapore, including licensing questions, client agreements and disputes.
- [Singapore Manufacturing & Supply Agreements](https://beyondhorizons.sg/singapore-manufacturing-supply-agreements): Singapore and English law manufacturing, supply and distribution agreements, plus an optional AI-assisted contract review add-on.
- [Singapore Retrenchment Law](https://beyondhorizons.sg/singapore-retrenchment-law): Retrenchment law in Singapore (2026): what employers must do, and what is only good practice
- [Singapore Business Succession](https://beyondhorizons.sg/singapore-business-succession-lawyer): Business succession lawyer in Singapore for founders and family-owned companies
